one_line: Last Chahamana ruler of Ranthambhore who defied the Delhi Sultanate while sheltering Mongol fugitives.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a seasoned warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium wheatish Rajasthani complexion, neatly trimmed full beard and moustache, a small healed scar on the left cheek, and a calm but resolute default expression with sharp, focused eyes.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a low knot at the back of the head, mostly hidden under a crimson pagri-style turban with a wrapped tail, a narrow gold band at the base, and a small central turban jewel.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate late-13th-century Rajput war attire: a knee-length quilted cotton qaba (padded coat) in deep indigo with subtle vertical stitching and narrow red piping along the edges, worn over a long-sleeved off-white angarkha-style tunic; a broad russet-brown leather belt with a simple brass buckle cinches the waist, from which hangs a small cloth pouch; loose, cream-coloured churidar trousers gathered at the ankles; sturdy dark brown leather boots reaching mid-calf with simple stitching; over the qaba he wears a fitted mail shirt (zirah) rendered as tight steel rings ending just above the knee and at the wrists, with a plain iron gorget at the neck; a light saffron cotton patka (sash) with thin green borders wraps around his waist and trails slightly; jewellery is restrained—a single thin gold kada on his right wrist and a small, simple gold stud in each ear.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Rajput talwar with a steel blade, a brass hilt with a disc pommel and cross-guard, and a deep brown leather scabbard decorated with two narrow brass bands, worn slung from his belt on his left hip and often held unsheathed in his right hand.

ref_desc: Hammira of Ranthambhore is a mid-30s, broad-shouldered Rajput king with a wheatish complexion, trimmed beard, scarred left cheek, black hair in a low knot under a crimson turban, wearing an indigo quilted qaba over mail with cream churidar, saffron sash and leather boots, carrying a brass-hilted talwar in a brown scabbard in a deep indigo, crimson, saffron and cream palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Hammira of Ranthambhore as a dignified late-13th-century Rajput king: a mid-30s, athletic, broad-shouldered man with an oval face, wheatish complexion, neat full beard and moustache, a small scar on his left cheek, and calm, resolute eyes. His thick black hair is tied in a low knot and mostly hidden under a crimson pagri-style turban with a wrapped tail, a narrow gold band at the base, and a small central turban jewel. He wears a knee-length, deep indigo quilted cotton qaba with visible vertical stitching and red piping, over a long-sleeved off-white angarkha-style tunic, cinched by a russet-brown leather belt with a brass buckle and a small pouch. Over this sits a fitted steel mail shirt ending above the knee and at the wrists, with a simple iron gorget at the neck. His lower body is covered by cream-coloured churidar trousers and dark brown leather mid-calf boots with simple stitching. A light saffron cotton waist sash with thin green borders wraps around his belt and trails slightly to one side. Jewellery is minimal: a thin gold bangle on his right wrist and small gold studs in both ears. His signature weapon is a slightly curved Rajput talwar with a steel blade, brass hilt, disc pommel and cross-guard, in a deep brown leather scabbard with two brass bands, worn on his left hip; show him holding the unsheathed sword in one view and sheathed in another. Emphasise the deep indigo, crimson, saffron, cream and dark brown leather colour palette, and present him from front, side and back to clearly show hair, face, clothing details and weapon placement in a clean, historically grounded anime style.
